description: This file contains the implementation of a configuration class and methods for transforming requests and responses for the Fal AI Flux Pro v1.1-ultra model, a high-quality text-to-image generation model with support for image prompts. It defines parameters mapping, request transformation, and response parsing specific to this model.

methods.name: str _map_aspect_ratio(self, size: str)

methods.description: Creates the request body for the Flux Pro v1.1-ultra image generation API call, incorporating prompts and optional parameters.
